run_kmeans_clustering: run kmeans clustering on a torch tensor to get centroids and cluster assignments
build_kmeans_pipeline: build a clustering pipeline using faiss kmeans to group high-dimensional samples into N clusters
create_centroid_assignments: create per-sample cluster assignments and centroid distances from a set of feature vectors
test_kmeans_gpu: test the kmeans function with CUDA tensors to verify GPU-accelerated clustering works correctly
refactor_kmeans_seed: refactor the kmeans function to accept a configurable random seed instead of hardcoded zero
